The entry must keep the global publish after actor->field_938 and keep the scratchpad base in v0. Baseline UID 61 publishes through scalar MEM, and .sched has only UID 58 as its dependency, permitting it before actor load 11. The backward schedule chooses it late because its priority is 1 while most intervening struct stores have priority 2 or 3; .sched2 adds the reported potential-hazard effects.
